notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the screen would not load properly when adjusting or moving the window size during the game over state.
Additionally, I believe this fix will resolve the issue where the game over window does not appear properly on some computers. However, I will continue to monitor for any further display inconsistencies. If you encounter any issues, please leave a comment.
